item.description: Pick a color to use for the overlay that appears behind the play icon when hovering over the video.
item.label: Overlay Background Color

image.description: Upload your desired image, or type in the URL to the image you would like to display over your video. You can also generate a still image from your video.
image.label: Overlay Image

video.description: Upload your desired video in .MP4 format, or type in the URL to the video you would like to display.
video.label: Video MP4 File Or Youtube URL

webm.description: Upload the .WEBM version of your video here. All uploaded videos should be in both .MP4 .WEBM formats to ensure maximum compatibility in all browsers.
webm.label: Video WEBM File

module.description: Self-hosted or remote video player with optional poster image overlay.
module.name: divi/video
module.title: Video
